name: feature.bi.nodes
description: BI feature node pack (ADR 0417) — governed-metric reads over ctx.features.bi: list the closed-world metric catalog, fetch the prompt-facing catalog projection, and run ONE metric with bounded params (metricId + groupBy/since/until/bucket — never a filter AST). run-metric additionally emits the result as an interactive.chart artifact envelope so the run/chat workbench renders the numbers. role:action (recorded) — replay reads the recorded result.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: BI: List Metrics
nodes.description: Lists one organization's governed metric catalog over ctx.features.bi.listMetrics (system metrics plus the org's own; ADR 1052). Inputs: { orgId }. Output: { metrics } — each entry the definition plus a `stale` marker when it no longer fits its entity type. Org-guarded read.

nodes.label: BI: Get Catalog
nodes.description: Fetches one organization's prompt-facing metric catalog projection (metrics + closed vocabularies + promptMetricList, stale metrics left out of the list) over ctx.features.bi.getCatalog — the ADR 0358 live-catalog feed for agent prompts. Inputs: { orgId }. Output: { metrics, vocab, promptMetricList }.

nodes.label: BI: Run Metric
nodes.description: Evaluates ONE governed metric with bounded params over ctx.features.bi.runMetric. Inputs: { metricId, orgId, groupBy?, since?, until?, bucket? }. Output: { result } (with scope, groupsTruncated/droppedGroups and undatedRows when they apply; a stale metric fails typed) plus an interactive.chart artifact envelope (bar for grouped, line for bucketed) when points exist. Never accepts a filter AST.
